Definition: from G3878; inattention, i.e. (by implication) disobedience:--disobedience.
BiblicalUsage: Parakoē is disobedience, inattention, the failure to hear. By one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous; every transgression and disobedience receives a just recompence; and Paul is ready to revenge all disobedience when the Corinthians' obedience is fulfilled.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe disobedience is the hinge of the whole story. One man's not-hearing makes many sinners, and one Man's hearing makes many righteous.
